statements.action_statement: No fixed release is available yet; update when Docker Hardened Images publishes one.
statements.status_notes: CVE-2021-4217: unzip mishandles a Unicode path field in a crafted zip archive and dereferences a NULL pointer, so extracting the archive crashes unzip (https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/unzip/+bug/1957077, https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=2044583). Info-ZIP has released no fix; Debian lists trixie's 6.0-29+deb13u1 as unfixed and rates it unimportant (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2021-4217). This owner publishes one build of Debian's 6.0-29+deb13u1 in the DHI Debian repository, as unzip and unzip-dbgsym for amd64 and arm64, with no patch for this issue. Extracting the reproducer archive attached to the Launchpad report with that unzip, on amd64 and arm64, ends with "zipfile probably corrupt (segmentation violation)" and exit status 3, the same result as Ubuntu's vulnerable 6.0-25ubuntu1: unzip catches the crash in its signal handler. Every published version is affected.
